name: Sinkclose
impact: Ring-0 code with MSR access modifies SMM configuration despite the SMI lock, reaching ring-2 and enabling arbitrary code execution in system management mode
mitigation: AMD microcode/firmware updates (AMD-SB-7014); affects AMD processors back to 2006
boundary_statement: Sinkclose (CVE-2023-31315, AMD-SB-7014) allows ring-0 code to modify SMM configuration and execute code at ring-2, affecting AMD processors since 2006. No public source found claims it breaks an SEV-SNP confidential guest, so it is recorded for documentation and does not affect a platform verdict.

INTENT.evidence: AMD-SB-7014 describes SMM/SMI-lock circumvention and ring-2 execution. No vendor or research source found claims it breaks SEV-SNP guest confidentiality or integrity, so no platform tag is applied.
